name: report_problem
description: Call this when a Ledgerly API call fails and retrying does not help. Returns a case with committed ack_by and resolve_by times right away, then a verified answer, an executable outcome, or a bounded grant you may call yourself.

request_id.description: The Request-Id header or help.request_id from the failing response.

goal.description: What you were trying to do, in one sentence. Required to open a case; omit it when you send case_id to check status.

contact.description: Optional. How to reach your operator, such as an email.

case_id.description: Optional. Pass an existing case id to check its status instead of opening a new case.

outcome.description: Executable result: action, amount, currency, expires_at.

authority.description: Verbs you may now call, each with its cap and per-user limit.

wait.description: Seconds before polling again. Fallback when you cannot receive push.
